title: Buccaneers at Bears: Initial injury report for Week 9

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Buccaneers at Bears: Initial injury report for Week 9
sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers began preparations for their Week 9 matchup against the Chicago Bears on Wednesday, releasing their first injury report ahead of Sunday night’s game at Soldier Field. Tampa Bay listed eight players on the initial report, including three who did not participate in practice. Wide receiver Emeka Egbuka (foot) remained sidelined after […]
